about: The source model of an Imaris IMS file (HDF5; spec/virtualize/ims.md, spec/virtualize.md §8 <https://github.com/d-v-b/vzip/blob/main/spec/virtualize/ims.md#8-ims-profile>): the elements a parser emits, and the roles the Imaris layout's groups, attributes and datasets play, each with the constraints a file must meet to have the IMS convention's layout. The rules of the HDF5 subset (§8.1 <https://github.com/d-v-b/vzip/blob/main/spec/virtualize/ims.md#81-hdf5-structures>–§8.6 <https://github.com/d-v-b/vzip/blob/main/spec/virtualize/ims.md#86-attributes>: signatures, versions, sizes, addresses within the file, a chunked layout with a zero fill value, filter masks of 0, loops and duplicates) are the binary layer, checked by the HDF5 reader (`hdf5.rs`) where the profile reads each structure; a parser checks this schema while it parses, and projections read a valid IR and check nothing.

image_filters.about: the filters an image dataset may have: none, or deflate (1)

elements.about: The IR of an HDF5 file. Names in angle brackets are decimal indexes. Objects are numbered depth first from the root group, a group's hard links in ascending byte order of their names; a structure two objects name (the same bytes) is described once, the other an alias. Bytes no element claims (free space, unused allocations, structures outside the reader's subset) are gaps.

superblock.type: {signature,version,...} (48 bytes for versions 2 and 3, 96 or 100 for 0 and 1)

superblock_extension.about: the superblock extension's object header, as an object's

objects/<i>.about: object i (a group, dataset or named datatype): its header and the structures it names

children.prefix: the header's prefix (version 1: 16 bytes; version 2: OHDR to the first block's size)
children.checksum: <u4 after a version 2 header's first block
children.messages/<k>: struct: header {type,size,flags[,order]}, data (bytes; an attribute message a struct of prelude, name, datatype, dataspace, value; a link message a struct of fields, name, target)
children.blocks/<j>: a version 2 continuation block's signature (OCHK) and checksum
children.symbol_table: struct: heap (header, data), nodes/<k> (header, entries), snods/<k> (header, entries)
children.links: dense links: heap (header, blocks/<k>), index (B-tree v2: header, nodes/<k>), items/<j> (the link messages)
children.attributes: dense attributes: heap (header, blocks/<k>, huge index), index, items/<j> (the attribute messages)
children.index: the chunk index's structures (headers/<k>, nodes/<k>, data_blocks/<k>, index_blocks/<k>, super_blocks/<k>, pages/<k>)
children.chunks/<n>: data: the chunk at row-major grid index n; form geometry {chunk, size}, codec {filters, mask}, recipe the whole chunk

global_heaps/<k>.about:
a global heap collection attributes name: header, objects/

(header, data), free (header)

given.dataset: the root group has a link DataSet
given.level0: DataSet has a link ResolutionLevel 0 (absent before DataSet is read)

constraints.message: not an Imaris file (no DataSet group)

given.levels: consecutive links ResolutionLevel 0, 1, ..., counted to max_levels + 1

constraints.message: ImageSize{axis} of level {level} is not a positive integer

given.ieee32: bit fields and properties of IEEE binary32

constraints.message: floating-point data that is not IEEE binary32

image.about: a Data dataset of level r, as the datasets before it

given.larger: an ImageSize is larger than the dataset's size
given.same_type: its data type is the first dataset's
given.same_level: its sizes, chunk shape and filters are its level's first dataset's

constraints.message: a dataset of level {level} is not 3-dimensional
the image of level {level} is larger than its dataset
the datasets have different data types
the datasets of level {level} differ in size, chunk shape or filters

given.most: the largest Z of any level

constraints.message: a level has more than one z plane, and level 0 has one

about_builtins: Which groups are opened and in what order, the text of an attribute (UTF-8, else Latin-1, up to the first NUL), decimals, timestamps, the color and the walk of the IR (objects by level from the root group, the objects the layout reads first, at most walk_objects + walk_per_image × the Data datasets, to walk_depth) are code: spec/virtualize/ims.md §2 <https://github.com/d-v-b/vzip/blob/main/spec/virtualize/ims.md#2-the-source>–§5 <https://github.com/d-v-b/vzip/blob/main/spec/virtualize/ims.md#5-source-metadata> state them.
